title: Size after rewiring
statement: Let $C$ be a finite acyclic Boolean circuit with $N$ input vertices and gate list $G$, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. Suppose a list of $N$ source vertices has every entry less than $k+2$. Rewiring $C$ using these sources to obtain a circuit with $k$ inputs gives a circuit of size $k+3+|G|$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit with N input vertices
the source list has length N
every source vertex is less than k+2
